hook.name: UniswapCupHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the UniswapCup protocol that restricts pools to exact-input swaps only and collects a percentage fee from each swap's output. If the output token is non-native, the fee is converted back to ETH via a nested pool swap inside afterSwap. Collected ETH is forwarded to the factory owner, and transfer restrictions on UniswapCupTeamToken are updated after each swap.
